title: danielmiessler/LifeOS: a personal AI system for goals, work and learning
friendlyTitle: LifeOS organises personal goals and AI workflows
summary: LifeOS is an MIT-licensed personal AI harness that organises goals, skills, memory and repeatable workflows across life and work. The project is active, appeared among today’s leading AI-related GitHub movers and currently shows about 17,300 stars.
friendlySummary: LifeOS is an open-source system for using AI with goals, learning, work and reusable instructions. It is one of today’s popular AI projects on GitHub.
whyItMatters: It offers a concrete structure for turning personal objectives into agent-assisted plans and reusable procedures. People building their own personal knowledge or productivity system can inspect its templates and architecture rather than starting from a blank folder.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You can study its templates to build a more organised personal AI setup. Review its privacy and security choices before adding personal information.
